# QMD and Vault as EMA Substrate

## Main point
The old vault/QMD system should not be treated as an obsolete side-system.
It should be treated as a major substrate for EMA.

## What it provides
- direct filesystem truth
- durable documents/pages
- frontmatter metadata
- queryability
- link graph
- promotion surface for memory and canon
- practical bootstrap path without waiting for full native UI

## EMA-native framing
- vault -> shared document/graph substrate
- note -> page/artifact/object page
- QMD search -> workspace query layer
- vault maintenance -> substrate health/maintenance
